title: Ashen road
caption: Dark atmospheric acoustic instrumental for a scorched ancient landscape. Slow detuned baritone guitar figures, hollow clay drum taps spaced far apart, creaking bowed strings and faint metallic scrapes. A lonely unresolved melody returns through a bed of smouldering low drones. Intimate, raw and subtle 1990s gothic exploration score, long rests, restrained tension, absolutely no epic crescendo. A full two minute evolving instrumental with contrasting phrases, a quieter middle section and a natural decaying ending.
